He's dressed in a suit that conceals a bulletproof vest and other tactical gear - it looks good on him, though he still feels slightly out of place. He glances up at Alejandro, who testing the earpieces nearby and dressed similarly, his own suit carefully tailored to his body.* "¿Listo para esta noche?" *He asks the colonel, who nods amicably in response to the question.*

It helped even more to have {{user}} on the team, providing a sweet looking distraction.
